summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for incoming automated reviews (CodeRabbit and Copilot), auto-resolve them as they arrive, then collect staging performance baselines for the vault login path before deploying vault migration changes.
summary.outcome: All 23 review threads across 4 review rounds were resolved with real bug fixes committed; staging E2E performance baselines were captured for fresh vault creation, existing vault login, and session restore scenarios, saved alongside a GSD todo for an auth/refresh race condition discovered during measurement.

repo: The cron/loop skill enables automated PR monitoring: CronCreate with a GraphQL polling prompt runs every 5 minutes and can trigger /resolve-pr-reviews automatically.
CodeRabbit and Copilot sometimes post 'outside of diff range' comments that don't appear as unresolved GraphQL reviewThreads — these must be checked separately via the review body.
Staging DB was wiped, so IPNS resolve returns 404 for all vaults created via test-login (the old staging code never publishes to IPNS during wallet-created vault flow).
Core Kit (Web3Auth) DKG on Sapphire Devnet dominates login time: ~45s cold, ~9s warm (cached DKG state). Our vault-critical path is <1.5s total.
Auth token refresh on page reload triggers a race condition: 6 concurrent refresh calls fire, 2 fail with 401 and 4 succeed with 200.
The E2E test suite uses @johanneskares/wallet-mock with installMockWallet() for real secp256k1 ECDSA signing — the pattern to follow for Playwright wallet login scripts.
VaultBlobV2 type was removed; the functions now return Uint8Array directly.

code.finding: Real bug: directRootIpnsName (the vault key IPNS name) was being reused as the root folder IPNS name for folder traversal. Fixed by deriving both IPNS names separately with distinct HKDF info constants.

Real bug: broad try/catch wrapped both getVault() and fetchFromIpfs() calls, so an IPFS 404 (missing CID for existing user) would incorrectly trigger vault initialization. Fixed by giving getVault() its own isolated try/catch.
Sequence-0 conflict on IPNS publish was previously a warn-and-continue; changed to return an error/abort to prevent silent data corruption.
slice() was used where subarray() is correct for zero-copy Uint8Array views; switched to subarray().
Encryption table incorrectly described v2 blob as 'ECIES (key) + AES-256-GCM (metadata)' when v2 is key-only. Fixed to 'ECIES (wrapped rootFolderKey only)'.
Stale reference to VaultBlobV2 type (since removed); updated to reflect Uint8Array return type.

workflow: The /loop skill with CronCreate enables fire-and-forget PR monitoring: schedule a GraphQL polling prompt, then get auto-notified and auto-remediated when reviews land.

Playwright MCP browser_run_code cannot import Node modules (no require/dynamic import from node_modules); standalone .mjs scripts run via Bash with proper working directory are the correct approach for E2E measurement scripts.
window.ethereum injection must happen via addInitScript (before page load) not evaluate (after load) for Web3Auth wallet detection to work.
Native Playwright request/response events (page.on('request'/'response')) are more reliable than fetch monkey-patching for network timing across navigations.
For before/after perf comparisons on architectural changes, API-level timings are more meaningful than full E2E times when the dominant cost (Web3Auth DKG) is unaffected by the change.

friction: GitHub API timed out on one cron tick — transient network issue, no retry logic in the polling prompt.
Outside-diff-range review comments don't surface as unresolved GraphQL reviewThreads, causing them to be missed by the automated monitor until manually flagged.
Playwright MCP sandbox doesn't support Node module imports, requiring a full pivot from browser_run_code to a standalone Bash-executed script.
fetch() monkey-patching for network monitoring doesn't survive page navigations — had to rewrite to use Playwright's native request events.
Web3Auth OTP on staging is real (not a test bypass), blocking direct OTP-based login measurement.
Core Kit doesn't persist tKey shares across browser reloads in the mock wallet context, making true session restore measurement impossible without a persistent browser profile.
markdownlint failures blocked the initial commit of the baseline doc and todo file, requiring a fix pass before committing.
open_items: Auth/refresh race condition on page reload: 6 concurrent refresh calls fire, 2 fail with 401. GSD todo created at .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-auth-refresh-token-race-condition.md on branch perf/staging-baseline-2026-03-24.
Re-run staging-perf-wallet.mjs after PR #349 deploys to staging to get post-migration IPNS resolve timings with a real v2 key blob (checklist in .planning/perf/staging-baseline-2026-03-24.md).
True session restore baseline (Core Kit cached session, tab reopen within session lifetime) was not captured — requires a persistent browser profile across script runs.
Cron job cadb6bcb was cancelled at end of session; if PR #349 needs further monitoring it must be rescheduled.
Cleanup decision deferred: tests/web-e2e/staging-perf-wallet.mjs kept for post-deploy comparison but may need to be moved or gitignored if not part of the standard test suite.
